message: `override_byte_stride = 56` is not `stride = 40` of `vb0 = ResourcePosition`; the DLL doesn't compare them and the hash may match another buffer, so check it is intended.
`override_byte_stride = 72` looks like the strides of vb0, vb1 and vb2 added up (40 + 12 + 20); `vb0` alone is 40.
`override_byte_stride = 88` looks like the strides of vb0, vb1, vb2 and vb3 added up (40 + 12 + 20 + 16); `vb0` alone is 40.
